# Remote Control Agent v0.1.39 — Linux manual upgrade reliability

- Corrects a false manual-upgrade rollback when `systemctl --user restart` takes longer than the installer's previous 15-second subprocess deadline while systemd is stopping the old Agent.
- Extends only the bounded user-service restart wait to 45 seconds. Other subprocess timeouts remain unchanged.
- Preserves owner-local upgrade admission, quiescence and rollback guards, device identities, and durable SQLite operation receipts.
- Fixes a real WSL2 failure observed upgrading from v0.1.35; the unchanged v0.1.38 executable was restored after the previous timeout.
- Includes targeted regression tests and the existing native Linux x64/ARM64 and Windows x64 release-candidate CI.

Source change: lirtual/remote-control-agent#76. User device upgrades and cloud reconnect confirmation are separate acceptance steps; this release note does not claim them complete.
